name: Close by Equity Percent
summary: This EA monitors account equity as a percentage of balance and automatically closes all positions when equity reaches a user-defined profit or loss threshold. It acts as an equity-based risk management utility rather than a strategy-based trading system.
summary_zh: 该EA监控账户净值占余额的百分比，当净值达到用户设定的盈利或亏损阈值时自动平仓所有头寸。它是一个基于净值的风险管理工具，而非策略型交易系统。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不执行任何交易策略，而是作为账户级风险管理工具运行。其核心概念是当账户净值相对于余额达到指定百分比时触发全仓平仓。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不开仓交易。出场条件为：当净值百分比达到盈利目标（如余额的110%）或亏损极限（如余额的90%）时，关闭所有开仓头寸。仓位管理不适用，因为该EA不建仓。资金管理方面，该EA通过百分比阈值实现全局盈亏控制，本质上是账户级别的止盈止损机制。该工具适合同时运行多个策略时进行整体风险控制。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not execute any trading strategy but functions as an account-level risk management utility. Its core concept is to trigger a full position close when account equity relative to balance reaches a specified percentage threshold. Entry conditions are not applicable since the EA does not open trades. Exit conditions are: when equity percentage reaches the profit target (e.g., 110% of balance) or the loss limit (e.g., 90% of balance), all open positions are closed. Position sizing is not applicable since the EA does not open positions. For money management, the EA implements global profit/loss control through percentage thresholds, essentially serving as an account-level take-profit and stop-loss mechanism. This tool is suitable for overall risk control when running multiple strategies simultaneously.

parameters.name: EquityProfitPercent
parameters.description: 净值盈利百分比阈值，达到此值时平仓止盈

parameters.name: EquityLossPercent
parameters.description: 净值亏损百分比阈值，达到此值时平仓止损

parameters.name: CloseAllOnTarget
parameters.description: 是否在达到阈值时关闭所有头寸
parameters.description_en: Close all positions when threshold reached

parameters.name: CheckInterval
parameters.description: 检查净值的时间间隔（毫秒）

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定平仓的魔术号，0表示所有订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to distinguish trade instances

pros: 提供账户级别的盈亏保护，防止大幅回撤
基于百分比的阈值灵活可调，适应不同风险偏好
适合多策略并行运行时的全局风险控制
简单直观，易于理解和配置
pros_en: Provides account-level profit/loss protection against significant drawdowns
Flexible percentage-based thresholds adaptable to different risk appetites
Suitable for global risk control when running multiple strategies in parallel
Simple and intuitive, easy to understand and configure
cons: 仅在净值达到阈值时才触发，无法处理突发的跳空行情导致净值瞬间越过阈值的情况
平仓所有头寸可能导致不必要的止损，部分头寸可能仍有盈利潜力
缺乏分级平仓机制，无法分批减仓以降低市场冲击
不考虑点差和滑点对平仓执行价格的影响
cons_en: Only triggers when equity reaches threshold; cannot handle gap moves where equity instantly jumps past the threshold
Closing all positions may cause unnecessary stops as some positions may still have profit potential
Lacks staged closing mechanism, cannot reduce positions gradually to minimize market impact
Does not account for spread and slippage effects on closing execution prices
improvements: 增加分级平仓功能，允许分批减仓而非一次性全部平仓
添加通知功能（邮件、推送），在平仓时及时提醒用户
improvements_en: Add staged closing functionality allowing gradual position reduction instead of all-at-once closure
Add notification features (email, push) to alert users promptly when positions are closed

risk_points: 平仓时可能遇到滑点导致实际亏损超过设定阈值
在极端行情下可能无法及时平仓所有头寸
risk_points_en: Slippage during closing may cause actual losses to exceed the set threshold
In extreme market conditions, may not be able to close all positions in time

summary_en: This EA monitors account equity as a percentage of balance and automatically closes all positions when equity reaches a user-defined profit or loss threshold. It acts as an equity-based risk management utility rather than a strategy-based trading system.
